nodes.name: igc_business_map
nodes.summary: MySQL/InnoDB migration creating the igc_business_map table that persistently maps Instagram Business Account IDs to their connected REGOS integration, with active-status flag and audit timestamps. Transient queues, retries, dedupe, and route caches are kept in Redis rather than this table.
nodes.languageNotes: InnoDB table with utf8mb4_unicode_ci collation; business_id is the primary key with secondary indexes on connected_integration_id and is_active, and updated_at uses ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.
